name: Courabyra Wines
description: A family owned cellar door and vineyard in the foothills of the Snowy Mountains at Tumbarumba, making cold climate wines. Tastings run alongside a seasonal menu of regional produce with indoor and outdoor dining, and the property takes weddings, group functions and special events by arrangement. Vineyard tours, helicopter tours and picnic packages among the vines can be booked, and there is a children's playground.
highlights: Family owned cold climate vineyard and cellar door
Tastings with a seasonal regional menu
Indoor and outdoor dining
Vineyard tours, helicopter tours and picnics among the vines
Weddings and group functions by arrangement
Children's playground

name: Ladbroken Distillery Brewhouse
description: A craft distillery beside a stream on Albury Street in Tumbarumba, making small batch whisky, liqueurs and Eliksir gins shaped by the high country climate. The cellar door, cafe and shop pour tasting flights and craft beer alongside pizza, either in the interior speakeasy or out in the cocktail garden. Open Friday to Sunday, with private appointments by arrangement.
highlights: Small batch whisky, liqueurs and Eliksir gins
Cellar door, cafe and shop
Tasting flights, craft beer and pizza
Interior speakeasy or outdoor cocktail garden
Open Friday to Sunday, private appointments by arrangement

name: Syviers Coffee House
description: A cafe on the main street of The Rock serving breakfast, lunch, dinner, coffee and drinks seven days a week. Group bookings and takeaway are both catered for, and the business states it welcomes people with access needs.
highlights: On the main street of The Rock
Breakfast, lunch and dinner seven days
Group bookings taken
Takeaway available
Welcomes people with access needs

name: Latte Da Coffee Bar
description: A coffee bar on Green Street in Lockhart doing blackboard specials, gourmet sandwiches made to order, toasted Turkish rolls, pies and sausage rolls. The cake cabinet holds a mix of homemade and sourced cakes and slices, with cold drinks and milkshakes alongside. Pizza runs on Fridays. Pantry items are sourced locally, and there is indoor and outdoor seating as well as takeaway.
highlights: Blackboard specials and gourmet sandwiches made to order
Toasted Turkish rolls, pies and sausage rolls
Cake cabinet of homemade and sourced cakes and slices
Pizza on Fridays
Locally sourced pantry items
Indoor and outdoor seating, and takeaway

name: Coolamon Perk
description: A cafe on Cowabbie Street in Coolamon open six days a week for breakfast and lunch, with coffee, cakes, slices, wraps and sandwiches in a relaxed family friendly room.
highlights: Open six days a week
Breakfast and lunch
Cakes, slices, wraps and sandwiches
Relaxed and family friendly

name: Quest Griffith
description: Sixty eight serviced apartments on Railway Street in Griffith, running from studios to three bedroom apartments and suited to both short and long stays. Studios have kitchenettes; one bedroom and larger apartments have full kitchens and laundry facilities.
highlights: 68 serviced apartments
Studios through to three bedroom apartments
Full kitchens and laundry in one bedroom and larger
Suited to short and long stays
